meta.name: ATELIER MARIS | Casa Lumen
meta.description: A portfolio-grade cinematic architecture experience for a fictional Mediterranean studio, directed as a continuous journey from coastal approach through material, interior, landscape and inquiry.

media.alt: Modern residence on a rocky Mediterranean coastline

copy.headline: Architecture shaped by sea, light, and restraint.
copy.body: Casa Lumen is introduced as a sequence of thresholds. The coast establishes scale; architecture edits the horizon.

media.alt: Modern room opening toward an ocean horizon at sunset

copy.headline: A house drawn around the horizon.
copy.body: Two stone planes hold a shaded court. Glass disappears between them. The long axis ends at water, never at a wall.

media.alt: Sunlit modern atrium facing the sea

copy.headline: The entry compresses. The view releases.
copy.body: The approach narrows through stone and timber before the room opens in one controlled reveal. Forward enters the house; reverse reconstructs the threshold.

media.alt: Modern coastal kitchen and living space with ocean view

copy.headline: Stillness is designed, not decorated.
copy.body: Low furniture preserves the datum of the sea. Circulation follows the edge of the room so the center remains quiet and uninterrupted.

media.alt: Architectural material samples, sketches and tactile finishes on a studio table

copy.headline: Stone carries time. Timber carries touch.
copy.body: Travertine is honed rather than polished. Oak is quarter-sawn and brushed. Linen softens acoustics without asking for attention.

media.alt: Warm travertine wellness interior with restrained fixtures

copy.headline: Ritual spaces designed for stillness.
copy.body: A private bathing court is cut from the same stone language as the house. Water, shade and framed sky do the decorative work.

media.alt: Architectural studio space opening to daylight and landscape

copy.headline: Architecture begins with material intelligence.
copy.body: We work from section, climate and construction outward. Models, samples and light studies are decisions, not presentation theatre.

media.alt: Coastal architecture set against sea and rock

copy.headline: The horizon becomes the final room.
copy.body: The architecture recedes until stone, water and topography read as one field. The project ends where the site begins.

media.alt: Coastal residence at golden hour overlooking the sea

copy.headline: Let us shape your next residence.
copy.body: Private homes, interior transformations and coastal retreats. A fictional showcase built to demonstrate Forge at full production intent.

hotspots.label: Honed travertine
hotspots.description: Open-pore travertine is honed to hold diffuse light and preserve tactile depth rather than mirror it.

hotspots.label: Oak brise-soleil
hotspots.description: Vertical oak fins reduce low western glare while keeping the sea visible in motion between the blades.

hotspots.label: Water datum
hotspots.description: The pool edge is aligned with the sea horizon from the principal living position so foreground water visually joins the coast.
